worldcover_2021.note: window of the 10 m tile N39W003

terrain.lake_rule: WorldCover class 80 bodies of at least 1 km2 (8-connected)

flood_depth.label: ESTIMATED from the flood outline and terrain (FwDET rule, Cohen et al. 2018), not measured; says nothing about future storms
flood_depth.method: water surface of each flooded cell = ground of its nearest flood-edge cell; depth = surface - ground, at least 0; edges only where the flood touches mapped dry land with terrain that is not permanent water; no smoothing (docs/STREETS.md)

dana_2024_horta_sud.outline: EMSR773 maximum observed extent (flooded area plus flood traces, three products), whole grid
dana_2024_horta_sud.terrain: ICV MDT 1 m 2015 averaged to 5 m (not filled)

check_against_water_marks.source: ICV DANA2024.ZonasInundadas.AlturaAgua.* (UPV, IVE, SGRT, town halls): water heights surveyed after the flood

edges_in_the_ten_towns.note: checked after seeing the errors; building walls are not the main source of error

dana_adam_2026_pego_oliva.outline: EMSR935 (data/labels/pego_oliva_emsr935_flood.geojson), flooded area plus flood traces
dana_adam_2026_pego_oliva.terrain: ICV MDT 1 m 2015 sheet 0796 averaged to 5 m (not filled)

check_against_water_marks.result: no check: no surveyed mark lies inside the EMSR935 outline

water_marks_layer.what: water heights surveyed after the 2024 flood (MEASURED), every mark above 0 m whose 5 m cell lies in one of the 10 municipalities; coordinates in WGS84 with 5 decimals (about 1 m)
water_marks_layer.not_exported: marks on the analysis grid outside the 10 municipalities (no town for them here)

streets.title: Street by street: which method pointed to the streets that flooded, DANA of 29 Oct 2024, 10 towns of L'Horta Sud and Chiva
streets.note: Written with SI assistance (Claude Code), reviewed by the team.
streets.rules: docs/STREETS.md, section 'Street by street' (committed before any street score: commit 6e9bd5c)

methods.official_union: Official zones (SNCZI), any zone (union of T10, T100 and T500)
methods.terrain_hand_below_15m: Terrain: HAND below 15 m (PR #39 method 2, bare terrain, drainage above 0.5 km2)
methods.terrain_equal_area_union: Terrain: PR #39 equal-area cut (lowest HAND pixels of each town, as many as its pixels in any official zone)
methods.simulated_depth_above_0p3m: SIMULATED rain on terrain (PR #39): its own extent, maximum depth above 0.3 m
methods.simulated_equal_area_union: SIMULATED rain on terrain (PR #39): equal-area cut (deepest pixels of each town, as many as its pixels in any official zone)

what.key_A: flooded: in the EMSR773 observed flood (majority of sample points) or within 10 m of a surveyed water mark above 0 m (ICV)
what.key_B: flooded: UPV maximum depth above 0.1 m (majority of sample points); only on pieces whose midpoint lies inside the UPV outlines
what.equal_length: each ranking cut, town by town, to the street length the official zones (any zone) flag; terrain: median HAND lowest first; SIMULATED: median maximum depth deepest first
what.hit_rate_pct: share of the flooded street length flagged
what.precision_pct: share of the flagged street length that flooded
what.chance: a random choice of the same length: hit rate = flagged_pct_of_streets, precision = chance_precision_pct

descriptive.what: descriptive, computed after the headline: flooded streets outside every official zone, and the streets the SIMULATED extent (above 0.3 m) flags outside every official zone

key_b_surveyed_area_only_post_hoc.what: POST-HOC (added after the check of key B at the water marks, checks.upv_at_marks): key B on the pieces inside the UPV surveyed area (CGAT outline) only, where the map has a value at most wet marks; in the extra zones it has none at about half of them

descriptive.what: descriptive, computed after the headline: flooded streets outside every official zone, and the streets the SIMULATED extent (above 0.3 m) flags outside every official zone

key_b_surveyed_area_only_post_hoc.what: POST-HOC (added after the check of key B at the water marks, checks.upv_at_marks): key B on the pieces inside the UPV surveyed area (CGAT outline) only, where the map has a value at most wet marks; in the extra zones it has none at about half of them

upv_depth.title: Mapa d'inundació carrer a carrer de l'Horta Sud 2024 (maximum water depth, 29 Oct 2024)
upv_depth.publisher: Grup de Cartografia GeoAmbiental i Teledetecció (CGAT), Universitat Politècnica de València
upv_depth.coverage_note: water depth with buildings not masked (the viewer's 'Altura làmina (sense retallar edificis)'); the default layer H_lamina_sense_edificis is the same surface with building footprints removed
upv_depth.version: result updated 05/11/2026; 6,483 field points updated 20/06/2026 (viewer text)
upv_depth.method: flood marks measured with a staff on walls (Nov 2024 and May 2025), turned into water levels on the 2023 LiDAR terrain (IGN, 3rd coverage), interpolated into a water surface, minus the terrain
upv_depth.cite: Roch Talens, A., Pardo-Pascual, J. E., Almonacid-Caballer, J., Fernández-Sarría, A., Palomar-Vázquez, J., Cabezas-Rabadán, C. (2025): Mapa de calados máximos de las inundaciones del 29 de octubre de 2024 en l'Horta Sud y la Ribera, Cuadernos de Geografía 114-115: 347-374, doi:10.7203/CGUV.114-15.32144
upv_depth.licence: no licence named; the viewer says 'The data are freely available through the WMS server' and asks to cite the article above; the GeoServer capabilities (WMS, WCS, WFS) say Fees NONE, AccessConstraints NONE. Used here for derived numbers only; the raster is not redistributed (it stays in data/interim, not in git)
upv_depth.rule: each 5 m cell centre of the analysis grid takes the native 0.5 m pixel that holds it; NaN = no value
